guidance.statement: Noida hospital expected to break even in H2FY27
Mature hospital EBITDA margin expected to remain in 24-25% range
Noida expected to achieve EBITDA breakeven earlier than previous expectations

operating_notes.text: Noida occupancy around 30% with ARPOB near ₹70,000-80,000 on a small cash-only base.
Patna occupancy near 70%; Lucknow and Patna combined occupancy 68% in Q4FY26.
International revenue grew 33% to ₹2,780 million, 7% of consolidated revenue.
Network operational bed capacity was 3,737 after adding 72 beds in Q1FY27 (51 Noida, 21 Lucknow).
Announced expansion pipeline represents nearly 3,350 additional beds.
International patient revenue grew 23% YoY to ₹78.2 Cr; OPD pharmacy revenue grew 51% to ₹60.9 Cr.

timeline.summary: On 15 May 2026 Medanta's Q4FY26 call guided FY27 capex of ₹800-900 Cr and Noida break-even in H2FY27, after FY26 revenue rose 20% to ₹4,509 Cr.
